TITLE: A sausage floating between two fingers?
NEXT: NEXT: Your eyes have a boss too?

EN.두 검지 끝을 눈앞 한 뼘에서\n맞대요:
Touch the tips of your index fingers
a hand-span in front of your eyes
EN.손가락 말고\n먼 벽을 보세요:
Don't look at your fingers —
look at a far wall
EN.지금 해 보세요!\n눈은 먼 곳에:
Try it now!
Eyes on something far away
EN.손가락을 더 떼면\n소시지가 줄어요:
Pull them further apart
and the sausage shrinks
EN.공중에 뜬 손가락 소시지!: A finger sausage floating in the air!
EN.위에서 내려다보면\n두 눈은 조금 떨어져 있어요:
Seen from above,
your two eyes are a little apart
EN.먼 곳을 볼 때 가까운 손가락은\n눈마다 다른 자리에 보여요:
When you look far away, your close fingers
show up in a different place for each eye
EN.왼눈 그림과 오른눈 그림을: The left eye's picture and the right eye's picture…
EN.뇌가 하나로 겹치면: When your brain overlaps them into one
EN.두 손가락 끝이 겹친 곳 = 소시지!: Where the two fingertips overlap = the sausage!
EN.한쪽 눈을 감으면?\n겹칠 그림이 없어 사라져요:
Close one eye?
There's nothing to overlap, so it disappears
EN.이렇게 두 그림을 겹쳐서\n멀고 가까움을 알아요:
Overlapping two pictures like this
is how you tell near from far
